issue.title: [dhcp_relay] dhcp6relay memory issue resulting in segfault

failure.body:
#### Description
DHCPv6 Relay tests are failing on armhf with dhcp6relay resulting in segfault

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. On version 20201231.48, 20201231.49, 20201231.50, run dhcpv6 relay management tests
2. Tests fail and dhcp6relay results in segfault

#### Describe the results you received:
// Initialization
Jan 23 <IPV6>.690932 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === add config for intf Vlan1000
Jan 23 <IPV6>.692032 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === associating config 0x16c59a8 intf Vlan1000 with db connector 0xbe834b3c

// a good relay
Jan 23 <IPV6>.473310 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === callback updating #2 config 0x16c59a8 message type 1(0x1)
Jan 23 <IPV6>.474304 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === send_udp updating #1 config 0x16c59a8 message type 12(0xc)

// some more good relays
Jan 23 <IPV6>.065216 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: message repeated 3 times: [ === send_udp updating #1 config 0x16c59a8 message type 12(0xc)]

// This seems to be the problem. The config address changed (last byte got zeroed out):
Jan 23 <IPV6>.065699 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === server_callback updating #3 config 0x16c59a8 message type 13(0xd)
Jan 23 <IPV6>.066095 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === send_udp updating #1 config 0x16c5900 message type 2(0x2)

// crashed then restarted:
Jan 23 <IPV6>.674247 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === add config for intf Vlan1000
Jan 23 <IPV6>.674478 str2-7215-acs-3 WARNING dhcp_relay#dhcp6relay: === associating config 0x1a449a8 intf Vlan1000 with db connector 0xbe9dbb3c

#### Describe the results you expected:
Config address should stay the same upon receiving and sending packets.

resolution.title: [dhcp6relay] a couple memory access protections
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
1. the strcpy and buffer allocation is not safe, it corrupts 1 byte on the stack. Depending on the memory layout, it may or may not cause issue immediately.
2. message type is not validated before updating the counter. Which could cause segment fault.

#### How I did it
1. Remove the unsafe strcpy, use config->interface.c_str() instead.
2. Check message type before updating counters.

#### How to verify it
The issue (1) caused segment fault on a specific platform. The fix was validated there. Issue (2) was precautionary. Added log in case it triggers.

- [ ] 201911
